keyVerseDR: "Be of good heart: it is I, fear ye not." (Mt 14:27)

level1.title: Jesus Walks on Water
level1.story: Jesus walked on the water to His friends' boat. Peter walked on the water too, but he got scared and began to sink. Jesus took his hand and saved him.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What happened when Peter got scared?
When do you need Jesus' hand?

activity.title: The boat on the sea
activity.intro: Color by number to finish the boat.

level2.title: Peter Walks on Water
level2.story: After feeding the crowd, Jesus sent the disciples ahead by boat and went up the mountain to pray. During the night, the wind was against them, and Jesus came walking on the sea. The disciples were terrified, but Jesus said, "Be of good heart: it is I, fear ye not." Peter walked on the water toward Jesus, but when he saw the wind, he became afraid and began to sink. Jesus caught him and said, "Why did you doubt?" and they worshiped Him, saying, "You are the Son of God."
level2.keyLine: Be of good heart: it is I, fear ye not.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why did Peter begin to sink?
How can you keep your eyes on Jesus?
level2.prayer: Jesus, when I sink, catch me. Amen.

activity.title: Fix the words
activity.intro: Three words are wrong. Cross them out and write the right words.
activity.text: Be of good {cheer|heart}: it is {Peter|I}, {doubt|fear} ye not.

art.mainBrief: Jesus walking on water reaching for sinking Peter
art.heartBrief: Waves at bottom, Jesus' hand reaching up
